Title: Data transfer from Azure Origins to Azure CDN from Microsoft is now free of charge

Body.Content:
Announcing that data transfer from Azure services, such as Azure Storage, Azure Media Services, Azure Application Gateway, and more, to Azure CDN from Microsoft will be free of charge starting October 2019. The change to enable this was rolled out in early September and customers will see reduced charges starting with their October invoice. 

Learn more
